home.heroTitle: Bridging Oceania and China, Empowering Business Growth
home.heroText: Based in Melbourne, the Oceania Business Association connects governments, chambers and enterprises across China and Oceania — providing members with trade facilitation, policy insight and cross-border support.
home.newsStandfirst: Association news, trade cooperation and industry insight.
home.aboutTitle: A not-for-profit business association based in Oceania
home.aboutText: Headquartered in Melbourne and recognised by government and business communities in both Australia and China, the association hosts regular business events, forums and trade missions, and provides targeted matchmaking services for practical cooperation between Chinese and Australian enterprises.
home.chaptersStandfirst: Industry-led committees spanning education, construction, real estate, talent and innovation, and business services.

about.title: About
about.standfirst: Oceania Business Association Incorporated is a Melbourne-based, not-for-profit membership association.
about.introTitle: A business bridge between China and Oceania
about.introBody1: Headquartered in Melbourne, the association builds an efficient platform for business exchange between Australia and China — hosting regular business events, forums and trade missions, and providing targeted matchmaking services.
about.introBody2: The association is recognised and supported by government departments and business communities in both countries, and maintains partnerships with multiple Chinese provinces and cities to support members entering Oceania and China markets.
about.visionText: A multilateral business hub bridging China, Australia and wider Oceania — empowering Chinese enterprises going global and Australian enterprises expanding into the Asia-Pacific.
about.missionText: Connecting government and business resources through industry chapters to provide members with end-to-end cross-border support and steady growth in Oceania markets.
about.structureText: At the 2026 Annual General Meeting the association launched six professional committees — spanning education, construction, real estate, high-level talent and doctoral innovation, and business services — together with a Canberra branch.
about.partnershipsText: The association maintains partnerships with Chinese provinces and municipalities including Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Anhui, Shanghai, Yunnan, Guangdong and Inner Mongolia.
